sourceTitle: The Religion of Geology and Its Connected Sciences
description: "The Religion of Geology and Its Connected Sciences" by Edward Hitchcock is a scientific publication written in the mid-19th century. The work explores the interplay between geology and religion, particularly how scientific discoveries can complement and illustrate religious truths.
